$description: Canonical KPI field definitions — single source of truth for Stats Agent and downstream consumers.

total_actions.description: Total distinct action instances in the current view

over_2m.description: Actions exceeding the slow-action threshold — count + share
over_2m.rename_reason: Threshold value varies per dataset; over_2m is misleading when threshold is not 2 minutes

median_duration.description: p50 of action end-to-end duration (start to last render end)

label_note: The label on over_2m reflects the configured threshold. Always use key to identify items, never label.
scope_note: KPIs reflect the currently filtered/visible action set, not necessarily the full dataset. Anomaly counts may use a different denominator when filters are active.
